$comment: `"devtools": false` at the TOP LEVEL — the place docs/DEVTOOLS.md has always documented, and which the builders only started copying into the manifest's window block in m22. Since m22 it is the static spelling of `appDevtools.disable()`: this host binds no devtools port at all. `VN_DEVTOOLS=1` in the environment overrides it, which is what keeps an app from being able to make itself undebuggable.
name: devtools-off
